notes.title: New videos about the making of 'the static speaks my name'
notes.content:
For those who are interested, I've just started a YouTube channel. Some of my first videos dive into the creation of the static speaks my name. In one video, I talk about the development and release of the game. In another, I show the prototype for the game that was created as part of a 48 hour game jam.

Making and releasing 'static' - https://youtu.be/IGFIApK7CHI
The lost 'static' prototype - https://youtu.be/G_dxDxn--L0

The channel will cover my past games (the static speaks my name, Bucket Detective, and more) as well films and stories I've been working on. Since I'm still figuring out what to do with the channel, I'm also open to suggestions. More than anything I'm trying to make it a fun, experimental, engaging place for discussing games, movies, books, and creativity in general. Come join!

notes.title: Wot I Think: Bucket Detective
notes.content:
How much of yourself would you sacrifice to create a literary masterpiece? Bucket Detective [official site], the new game from the creator of The Static Speaks My Name, is not interested in the answer to that question. Instead, it asks what you, in the role of forty-one year old man David Davids, will give up to write a trashy book that’s sure to get you laid. Since seeing each of the endings, the discovery of which is largely based on the answer to the question how far will you go? , I’ve settled on a single word that captures my feelings about Bucket Detective.

Grubby. It’s a grubby little thing, for better and for worse.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Bucket Detective has been released!
notes.content:
Not much more to say than that!

Check it out, and if you like the game, take a look at the in-game audio commentary about the making of the game. I recorded it yesterday and I think it turned out pretty well. In a few weeks I'm going to update the in-game commentary to answer questions from players, so if you have anything you want answered, post it here or email me at thewhalehusband@gmail.com.

We've already fixed a few small bugs that a couple players encountered, and we're going to be aggressive about fixing anything else that comes up, so if you have issues, let us know.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Bucket Detective combats writer s block with cult rituals
notes.content:
Bucket Detective [official site] – a comedy/horror game by the creator of The Static Speaks My Name – is out today. Given Adam called The Static Speaks My Name “possibly the funniest game I’ve played this year” in his 2015 roundup I have high hopes for Bucket Detective.

As per the Steam description, it’s a mostly linear game where you “Help a cult complete a strange ritual in exchange for divine inspiration to finish writing your terrible novel.” … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Three weeks to launch!
notes.content: We're currently finishing up the last bits of the game - putting in final art, audio, music, achievements, trading cards, etc. After that we're going to be bug testing and sending out to press in the hopes we can get the game covered. My programmer and I have been working on this game for a year and a half, so we're super excited to finally be releasing!
